objective: Map and display the owner's 1300 character story collectible artworks (13 characters × 20 levels × 5), preserve server-owned levels and item ownership, and add accessible motion and staging validation.
productionBaselineEvidence: Compared with main commit 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61. No production OTA, native package, database migrations, AdMob, navigation or server-auth changes.
chosenApproach: Canonical deterministic item paths verified by supplied art ZIP and SHA256 manifest. HTTPS public art URLs remain disabled until all 1300 objects verified. Keep masked locked specials; use whole-illustration idle only with reduced-motion awareness.
preserveBehaviors: Server-owned per-character level and XP, Circle Rank, item claims and rewards unchanged.
Core/Special identities and masked locked special previews preserved.
All existing AdMob, Wall, Connect, auth, navigation and production OTA functionality left intact.
Missing art displays safe fallback; never grants collectible ownership.
Character level art still uses existing approved sprite sheets.
acceptanceChecks: Exactly 1300 unique art paths, no traversal or duplicates.
Core/Special item preview, unlocked art and reduced-motion/bkg pause present.
Git visual lock rebaselined against reviewed changed visual files and all existing Character release invariants maintained.
CI: TypeScript, Character and appwide regression gates before staging OTA.
Stage only after all WebP objects publicly verify SHA256 and preview EAS URL is configured.
Skip actual-device test only per user, retain CI gates.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add existing-art collectible previews and subtle accessible motion on Character screens only; preserve native identity and app behavior.
preservedBehaviors: Server-side login, auth, app runtime, AdMob and navigation unchanged.
All animations pause in background and honor reduce-motion setting.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Map each of 1300 story collectibles to canonical character, own level and slot, keeping Special identity locks and canonical server-owned progression.
preservedBehaviors: No reallocation of points, rewards, XP, Circle Rank or collectible entitlement.
Special identity remains hidden until rank unlock, using existing visibleSpecialRail gate.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Rebaseline exact reviewed protected R31/R40 Character source blob SHA values while retaining fail-closed source and compiled-bundle release gates.
preservedBehaviors: No OTA workflow or production release action introduced.
SHA lock remains enforced on every modified protected Character surface.

selectionRationale: Existing BUKLOD Character V2/R31/R40 and verified 1,300-item Library artwork already define the visual identity. Implement deterministic mapping and preview in those clients rather than creating a parallel character inventory, while preserving server-level and rank authority.
alternativeApproaches: Bundle all 1,300 images in every Android OTA (rejected: bloat, slower installs and unnecessary asset updates).
Reuse generic icons without rendering the uploaded artwork (rejected: user explicitly requires actual visually mapped items).
Animate separate head, eyes and limbs using flat JPG/PNG art (rejected: invalid rigging without segmented, reviewed pivots).
